name: io.github.cocoindex-io/cocoindex-code
title: CocoIndex Code
description: Semantic code search over a local repository, with AST-based chunks and incremental re-indexing.

runtimeArguments.name: --with
runtimeArguments.description: Install the full extra, which adds sentence-transformers for local embeddings. The default embedding model needs it.

environmentVariables.name: COCOINDEX_CODE_ROOT_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Root directory of the codebase to index. Set it when the client does not start the server inside the codebase. If unset, the server uses its working directory.
